C0273.title: Jiangsu Taicang Police Use Big Data Models to Catch Web Crawlers in Piracy Cases
C0273.summary: According to a January 2026 report, Taicang police handled two intellectual-property cases. In July 2023, original novels from a well-known reading platform were illegally crawled, distributed, and monetized, causing losses above RMB 10 million; police arrested 25 people across five provinces and nine cities, shut down more than ten websites and public accounts, and found over 200,000 stolen novel chapters. In March 2025, paid drama episodes from a video platform were technically pirated; police arrested nine people, found 36,000 pirated film and TV resources, reported losses above RMB 10 million, and formed a cross-regional enforcement result with clear enforcement impact.
